name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
description: As a Bonus Action, you can touch a Simple or Martial weapon and infuse it with one of these damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. For 1 minute, the weapon deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type on a hit. When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage, you can use a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that instance of damage.
